enrichment-abilities.json.name: Backroom Deals
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] While the selected unit is leading a unit, models in that unit gain Infiltrators; the Declare Battle Formations 'select one of those units' pick is not modeled. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Warrant of Trade
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] After deployment, select up to D3 Imperium Battleline units (modeled as a flat 3 — the selector count cannot be a dice expression) and redeploy them; the option to set those redeployed units up in Strategic Reserves (regardless of the usual reserve limit) is not modeled. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Extremis Sanction
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Officio Assassinorum units may use Overkill, Soulless Horror and Shieldbreaker twice per battle instead of once (still max once per battle round); the per-army points surcharge and Extremis mustering rules are army-build effects. Usage-limit change is not directly expressible. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Decoy Targets
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Callidus Assassin models only; the selected friendly model is destroyed ignoring on-death rules and this model is set up as close as possible to where it was, outside Engagement Range; usable at most once per battle round

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Esoteric Explosives
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] When this model is targeted with the Grenades Stratagem, it inflicts a mortal wound on each D6 of 3+ instead of 4+ — a modifier to another Stratagem's dice, not directly expressible. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Intraneural Biotech
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Encodes the −1 CP when this Eversor Assassin is targeted with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem; the clauses that the use is allowed regardless of other uses of that Stratagem this phase and does not prevent other uses of it are not modeled. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Micromelta Rounds
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: community-authored from 11e Imperial Agents faction pack; see #21

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Prime Target
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Until end of phase, the selected unit's attacks against Character units re-roll Wound rolls of 1; the upgrade whereby an Officio Assassinorum model attacking the enemy Warlord re-rolls the Wound roll entirely (not just 1s) is not modeled. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Hyperstimms
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: community-authored from 11e Imperial Agents faction pack; see #21

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Will-sapping Salvo
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: community-authored from 11e Imperial Agents faction pack; see #21

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Orbital Oversight
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: community-authored from 11e Imperial Agents faction pack; see #21

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Blind Grenades
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Encodes the base −1 to the charging enemy unit's Charge roll; when the protected unit is a Vindicare Assassin the penalty is −2 instead, which is not separately modeled. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Ensnaring Trap
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Grants an out-of-phase charge and the Callidus Assassin +1 to Wound roll; the 'does not receive a Charge bonus' clause and the melee-only narrowing of the Callidus bonus are not modeled. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: On My Signal, Fire!
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] After this unit shoots, marks one enemy unit it hit so attacks against it re-roll Hit rolls; the restriction that only AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM or IMPERIUM INFANTRY BATTLELINE models benefit is not modeled. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Tox-cycler
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] After this unit shoots, if the Jindarii tox-cycler scored a hit, that weapon gains +2 Strength and +2 Damage for the rest of the battle; the maximum Damage cap of 6 is not modeled. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: At All Costs
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] At the start of your Command phase, pick one option. Eliminate marks one enemy unit (Agents attacks against it +1 Hit); Acquire selects one objective marker and buffs Agents units within range of THAT marker (+1 Ld, +1 OC, 5+ invuln) — the objective-marker selection is generalized to any controlled/within-range objective. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Root out Heresy
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Ranged weapons gain [IGNORES COVER], and gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] against Chaos units; the restriction to Adeptus Arbites, Inquisitor, Inquisitorial Agents and Ordo Hereticus models, and the target threshold of Chaos units containing 5 or more models, are not modeled. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Deathwatch Mission Tactics
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] At the start of your Command phase select one Mission Tactic, active until your next Command phase, applied to all Deathwatch units; each tactic usable once per battle (consumable). Purgatus Tactics' Critical-Wound-gated [PRECISION] is modeled as a flat Precision grant. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Destroy the Daemonic
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: community-authored from 11e Imperial Agents faction pack; see #21. Applies to Inquisitor, Inquisitorial Agents and Ordo Malleus models from your army.
